requirements.requirement_summary: Use controlled seven-intent vocabulary
Return confidence from 0 to 1
Escalate below configured confidence threshold
Support secondary intents and policy precedence
UNCLEAR always escalates
Do not assert invoice or payment facts without tool retrieval
DELIVERY_DISPUTE must invoke verify_invoice_delivery
ALREADY_PAID_CLAIM must invoke reconcile_payment_claim
PAYMENT_PLAN_REQUEST must invoke get_payment_history and get_risk_score
Maximum tool calls per decision defaults to eight
Identical tool and identical arguments may occur at most twice
Required tool error or no result causes escalation
Record every tool call and result with an identifier
Obtain risk score through tool before autonomous action
LLM must not generate substitute risk score
Policy decisions use risk band rather than raw score
Missing or stale risk defaults to highest risk band
Include top contributing factors in escalation
Use controlled seven-action vocabulary
Use schema-validated structured action rather than prose parsing
Action includes channel message rationale evidence IDs risk and policy version
Use EMAIL SMS or HUMAN_CALL_FLAG channels
Channel selection accounts for consent responsiveness risk and quiet hours
Escalate when no permissible action exists
Every proposal passes deterministic validator
Hard constraints live in application code without LLM dependency
Hard violation rejects and escalates
Log violated constraint identifier and field
Permit at most one revision after rejection
Validator independently unit-testable without agent
Escalation packet contains reply intent tools risk proposed action rejection and history
Suspend autonomous action until human disposition
Record human disposition
Packet must be legible to nontechnical reviewer
Retrieve prior promises before a new promise
Retrieve prior disputes and resolutions
Retrieve prior escalations and dispositions
Third unsupported ALREADY_PAID_CLAIM mandates escalation
Use exact relational records when exact query exists
Classify debt as CONSUMER or COMMERCIAL and default ambiguity to CONSUMER
Consumer SMS or telephone restricted outside configured hours
Email exempt from quiet hours while honoring preference
Enforce rolling seven-day contact-frequency limit

requirements.requirement_summary: Evaluate quiet hours at proposed send time
Use retrieved ledger evidence and prohibit misleading representations or consequences
SMS requires affirmative consent
Channel opt-out is immediate and permanent
Channel opt-out requires escalation
No autonomous discount waiver or writeoff
Payment plans respect duration and down-payment bounds by risk band
Legal bankruptcy regulatory death or serious-illness language escalates
Disputed amount over threshold escalates
Firm tone for high-value or high-tenure accounts requires escalation

requirements.requirement_summary: No autonomous service hold
Bounds and thresholds are external machine-readable parameters
Policy-bound changes do not require Python code changes
Log policy version with every decision
Distinguish hard and soft constraints
Maintain required relational entities
Synthetic data generator is parameterized with documented data-generating process and explicit seed
Synthetic data includes required customer archetypes
Log decision intent debt classification tools risk action validation policy cost and latency
Audit trail is append-only and exportable
Escalation packet is suitable for nontechnical review
Maintain documented usage policy
Configuration kill switch can force all decisions to escalation
Specify retraining protocol without implementing automated retraining
